DOP: gabbati gabbeti ~ayati, pr. 3 sg. [ S. Dhātup garvati, garvayate, Wg §§ 15:74; 35:53 ], is proud; is confident ; Dhātum 289 (gabba dappe); Sadd 406, 27 (gabba dappe: … ~ati); 554, 21 foll. (gabba māne: … ~eti ~ayati … ~etī ti na saṅkucati); — pp gabbita , mfn. [ S. garvita], proud; self-confident ; Abh 1075; Ja II 340, 13´ (yaso hāyati issariyaṃ ~-bhāvo parihāyatī ti, Ce, Ee so; Be issariyagabbitabhāvo; Se issariya-labhitabhāvo); Ap 609, 4 (sutvāna nopagacchāmi mama rūpena ~ā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se gabbhitā); Sv 929, 6 (na apamādena na dīnena na ~enā ti attho, Ce so; Be na appamodena na dīnena na gabbhitenā ti; Ee na apamadena na dītena na ~enā ti attho; Se na appamādena na dinnena na vambhitenā ti; Sv-pṭ III 142,17 foll. : odagyasabhāvattā na dīno dhammūpasaṃhitattā gabba-yutto ti āha, Ee so; Be gabbhayutto ti); Sadd 554, 22 (~o); — ~-sabhāva, mfn. , proud or conceited by nature ; Ja III 264, 11´ (dittasabhāvaṃ ~-sabhāvaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se omits ); — see also gabbhati 2 .
